_help: Team names must match the Team Scores list exactly, for example Seattle Seahawks. Everything below is optional, and all of it is normally read from ESPN automatically; fill fields in only to override ESPN. divisionWinners: teams that won their division (+5 each); if not empty it replaces ESPN's whole list, so list all 8. playoffWins: a number per team, like {"Seattle Seahawks": 3}. confChamps: a list of team names. sbChamp: a single team name. Leave them empty to use ESPN's results.
